path: cvpr2026/FreeArtGS_Articulated Gaussian Splatting Under Free-moving Scenario.pdf
title: FreeArtGS Articulated Gaussian Splatting Under Free-moving Scenario
one_line: Free-moving articulated reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting, limited to two-part objects.
innovations: Free-moving part segmentation without static base assumption
method_framework: Three-module framework: free-moving part segmentation using point tracking and features, joint estimation from part transformations, and end-to-end Gaussian Splatting optimization for geometry, texture and articulation.
experiment_framework: FreeArt-21 benchmark (21 objects), Video2Articulation-S dataset, real-world objects; metrics: joint axis/position error, Chamfer distance, PSNR.
takeaways: Motion-based part segmentation without static base assumption
Combining off-the-shelf priors with optimization for robustness
relevance_reason: 3D重建技术，与可靠性主线无交点
